## Ecuador for travellers who want to explore on foot

Outdoor activity is central to this itinerary. It includes hikes to volcanoes and through the highlands, zip-lining, Class IV to IV+ rafting, walks in nature reserves and boat excursions. Several days are spent at elevations of about 4,000–5,000 m, so the route suits travellers who enjoy physical exertion and long walks.

The pace changes in the Galápagos. Mountain trails give way to Santa Cruz, lava tunnels, giant tortoises, Bartolomé and one of two boat excursions: North Seymour or South Plaza. You may see sea lions, iguanas, blue-footed boobies, frigatebirds, Galápagos penguins, rays, sharks and sea turtles.

This part of the itinerary lasts 5 days and 4 nights and takes you through several of Ecuador’s highland regions.
